title: Meeting Rooms II
description: Find the minimum number of conference rooms required for given meeting intervals.
pseudocode:
1. Separate start times and end times into sorted arrays
2. Iterate through start times with pointer s and end times with pointer e
3. If start[s] < end[e], increment rooms
4. Else, increment e (a room became free)

steps.note: Sort start times [0, 5, 15] and end times [10, 20, 30]
Compare start[0]=0 and end[0]=10. 0 < 10, room needed.
Compare start[1]=5 and end[0]=10. 5 < 10, room needed.
Compare start[2]=15 and end[0]=10. 15 >= 10, room freed.
Compare start[2]=15 and end[1]=20. 15 < 20, room needed.

fullDescription:
Given an array of meeting time intervals intervals where intervals[i] = [starti, endi], return the minimum number of conference rooms required.

Example 1:

Input: intervals = [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]
Output: 2

Example 2:

Input: intervals = [[7,10],[2,4]]
Output: 1

Constraints:

  • 1 <= intervals.length <= 104
  • 0 <= starti < endi <= 106
